tone.target: thick fuzzed stoner-rock crunch with bright bite
tone.profile: thick fuzzed stoner-rock crunch with bright bite
tone.summary: A thick, fuzzed signal chain using a fuzz pedal into a British-style amp (UK 45) with a powerful cab, emphasizing low mids and bright bite.
corrections: Make fuzz the main gain, not generic high gain.
Reduce delay/reverb; keep it mostly dry.

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise from heavy fuzz usage.
Provide initial grit and boost the signal into the fuzz stage.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used here as a mild pre-gain booster rather than a primary tone shaper, complementing the main fuzz gain.

alternatives.reason: A simple boost pedal would also work to raise the signal level.

blocks.purpose: Generate the core thick, saturated stoner-rock fuzz tone.
Add subtle filter movement and bite to the thick fuzz tone.
blocks.gap: The V-Wah is used subtly here, not for sweeping effects, but to shape the upper mids/bite as requested.

alternatives.reason: Bypassing this module would also be acceptable if no filter movement is desired.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the British Marshall-style stack and provide punchy, thick mids.
Provide the classic British cabinet sound and necessary punch.
Fine-tune the tone to emphasize thick low mids and bright upper-mid bite.
Minimal modulation to add slight width without sounding washy (kept off by default).
blocks.gap: The Chorus is kept inactive and set minimally, fulfilling the requirement for a module while adhering to the 'dry' mandate.

alternatives.reason: Bypassing all modulation modules would be ideal.

blocks.purpose: Minimal delay for subtle rhythmic punch (kept off by default).
blocks.gap: The Digital Delay is kept inactive and set minimally, adhering to the 'dry' mandate.

blocks.purpose: Provide a subtle sense of space without sounding washy or ambient.
blocks.gap: The Room reverb is used sparingly (low mix) to add dimension, avoiding the 'washy' effect.

alternatives.reason: A Plate reverb could also provide a controlled sense of space.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and tone definition by swapping the default IR.

proposals.reason: Enhance punch and grit for stoner rock tone.
